films.title: Kerr効果：光の強さが位相を変える

visual_encoding.scientific_scope: Deterministic dual-polarization Manakov pulse propagation: one 80 km passive span, loss included, no EDFA/ASE or receiver/training result.
visual_encoding.geometry: A realistic macro fiber and precision fixtures give context. A cutaway exposes the computed field. The detailed field is an enlarged schematic of electric-field values, not a photon path, ray bundle, or physical motion of the fiber.
visual_encoding.axial_meaning: Position along the exposed segment encodes retarded time within a pulse at the displayed propagation distance; the centimeter-like specimen length is illustrative and is not 80 km mapped literally to a single spatial instant.
visual_encoding.camera_framing: The camera approaches the exposed core for a macro closeup. +/-240ps is the generated field geometry/data window, not an axis drawn across the image; the low-power outer tails may be outside the closeup framing. Camera paths are identical for the three cases.

display_time_upsampling.method: Linear interpolation of real/imaginary complex-envelope components in retarded time, followed by analytic evaluation of the illustrated carrier on that finer grid. Original exported sample knots and physical data are unchanged. This is display smoothing, not propagation refinement.
display_time_upsampling.phase_mask: Conservative interpolation: phase color is present only where the bracketing original phase_valid samples are valid.

visual_encoding.carrier: E_pol(t)=Re[A_pol(z,t) exp(-i 2 pi t / 12ps)]. The 1550 nm infrared carrier is invisible and far faster. Its period is enlarged for visibility; the envelope and envelope phase come from the numerical fields.
visual_encoding.field_components: The field curve coordinates are (displayed retarded time, E_y, E_x). The same phase in Ax and Ay preserves linear polarization at 45 degrees; envelope phase is never used as a polarization rotation.
visual_encoding.field_amplitude_units: sqrt(W), proportional to electric field for the supplied normalization
visual_encoding.envelope_geometry: The translucent envelope radius encodes absolute sqrt(Px+Py) on one fixed scale. It is an amplitude glyph, not a changing physical mode-field radius or a transverse electromagnetic simulation.
visual_encoding.amplitude_scaling: A single fixed mapping is shared by all cases and all distances. The 16 dB passive loss is retained; no per-frame or per-case normalization, gain compensation, or synthetic enhancement of the numerical field is applied.

phase_color.mapping: cyclic teal at 0, warm orange toward +pi/2, blue toward -pi/2, magenta at +/-pi
phase_color.mask: The supplied phase_valid mask hides phase colors below 1e-6 of each snapshot's peak. Absolute field and power arrays remain unchanged.

distance_mapping.meaning: An illustrative sweep through propagation distance, not a real-time transit video.

visual_encoding.display_interpolation: Native Blender linear shape-key interpolation between the 81 measured solver export distances (0,1,...,80 km); atlas phase colors interpolate between the same rows. Every MP4 frame is actually rendered by Cycles; no optical-flow interpolation or duplication to accelerate rendering.
visual_encoding.renderer_scope: Cycles traces visible studio illumination to render materials. It does not solve the nonlinear optical propagation; all data-driven field geometry is generated from the separate numerical artifacts.
